proof:
Source: Step 5 (part (e), the mass bound) of the parent proof, stated for any pair (X, Y) related by pull-back along η. Conventions: ℝ^P := Eucl P; φ(y) := r⁻¹ • (y − x); V := {y : φ(y) ∈ W} = φ⁻¹(W).
Definitions used (SimonGMT Chapter06.Mass):
- T.massOn W = sSup {ENNReal.ofReal(T ω) : ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ n W};
- ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ n W iff tsupport ω ⊆ W and covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(z)) ≤ 1 for all z.
1. Reduction. By sSup_le, it suffices to show ENNReal.ofReal(Y ω) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹) · X.massOn V for every ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ n W. Fix such ω.
2. Choose η by (A): η ∈ TestFormOn univ n with η(y) = (rⁿ)⁻¹ • ω(φ(y)) for all y. Let η̂ := rⁿ • η; it lies in TestFormOn univ n, a submodule. For every y, η̂(y) = rⁿ • (rⁿ)⁻¹ • ω(φ(y)) = ω(φ(y)), because rⁿ ≠ 0 (smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀). So η̂ = ω ∘ φ as functions.
3. η̂ is admissible for X.massOn V.
   (i) covectorEuclideanNorm(η̂(y)) = covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(φ(y))) ≤ 1 for all y, by admissibility of ω.
   (ii) φ is continuous, so tsupport(ω ∘ φ) ⊆ φ⁻¹(tsupport ω) (tsupport_comp_subset_preimage). Since tsupport ω ⊆ W, this is contained in φ⁻¹(W) = V (preimage_mono).
   Hence ENNReal.ofReal(X η̂) ≤ X.massOn V (GeometricCurrentOn.le_massOn).
4. Value of Y. As test forms, η = (rⁿ)⁻¹ • η̂, since (rⁿ)⁻¹ • rⁿ • η = η (smul_smul, inv_mul_cancel₀). By (B) applied to the pair (ω, η), Y ω = X η. By linearity of X (X.toCurrent is ℝ-linear, map_smul), Y ω = (rⁿ)⁻¹ · X η̂.
5. Since (rⁿ)⁻¹ ≥ 0, ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹ · X η̂) = ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹) · ENNReal.ofReal(X η̂) (ENNReal.ofReal_mul). This holds whatever the sign of X η̂.
6. By steps 3 and 5 and monotonicity of multiplication in ℝ≥0∞, ENNReal.ofReal(Y ω) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹) · X.massOn V.
7. Step 6 holds for every admissible ω, so step 1 gives Y.massOn W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal((rⁿ)⁻¹) · X.massOn {y | r⁻¹ • (y − x) ∈ W}. ∎
key_steps: For admissible ω, take η from (A) and η̂ := rⁿη; then η̂ = ω∘φ, so |η̂(y)| ≤ 1 and tsupport η̂ ⊆ φ⁻¹(W).
Y ω = X η = (rⁿ)⁻¹X η̂ by (B) and linearity; ENNReal.ofReal_mul and sSup_le give the bound.
